stage_semantics.latent_service_location: one fixed physical delivery stop in the City Logistics Environment
stage_semantics.active_customer: a latent service location activated by a Stage 2 instance
stage_semantics.cus_n: N distinct active physical service locations, not N packages, households, residents, or dwelling units

physical_location.held_out_city_policy: apply the frozen Los Angeles rule unchanged to the other ten cities, including held-out Jacksonville

core_match_methods.G1_containment: NSI point covered by Microsoft footprint polygon
core_match_methods.G2_near_area_consistent: nearest Microsoft footprint within 10 m and footprint-area factor at most 4, subject to manual audit

physical_location.unmatched_policy: preserve in the audit universe but quarantine from the official core
physical_location.stacked_nsi_policy: retain source rows, merge one physical footprint, and sum nonduplicated residential-unit evidence

residential_scope.mixed_use_policy: retain with mixed_use_flag; residential unit evidence only

units.semantic_label: modeled residential-unit point estimate, not verified dwelling count
units.positive_resunits_rule: use summed nonduplicated positive NSI resunits
units.zero_resunits_rule: use the conservative lower bound implied by NSI occtype and record the interval

geometry.G2_near_area_consistent: nearest footprint within 10 m and area factor at most 4
geometry.G0_quarantine: unmatched, ambiguous, or failed geometry evidence

road_access.eligible_graph: graph_operational; inside-city, non-transit-only delivery edges only

optional_terminal_sensitivity.source: the same frozen OSM PBF as graph_operational
optional_terminal_sensitivity.release_role: experimental appendix only; not required by Gate 2 v1 and never used to raise the official cover rate
optional_terminal_sensitivity.semantics: real OSM service/private-local ways retained only for sensitivity analysis; never eligible as through-route shortcuts
optional_terminal_sensitivity.permit_required_tier: retain for a separately reported delivery-permission sensitivity; excluded from the default profile
optional_terminal_sensitivity.prohibited_policy: access=no, motor_vehicle=no, or motorcar=no after tag-precedence resolution is excluded

selection_rule.coverage: choose the smallest candidate reaching at least 99% unit-weighted coverage in every city on graph_operational
selection_rule.type_coverage: report every service-location type, but do not make small-type coverage a v1 hard gate
selection_rule.manual_audit: inverse-probability-weighted plausible-access share must be at least 95% in every city and at least 90% in every service-location type; publish binomial uncertainty intervals
selection_rule.tail_sampling: stratify by city, service-location type, anchor method, and distance band; oversample the selected-threshold band and rejected records

road_access.over_threshold_policy: quarantine; never create a long synthetic driving edge
road_access.directionality: split the matched directed operational edge at a virtual access point, preserve u/v/key and legal direction, and never add customer-customer edges
road_access.private_access_reporting: optional appendix sensitivity only; never use private/service ways to make official v1 pass
